name: WordAI
tagline: WordAI is an AI article rewriter that rewrites existing content at the sentence and paragraph level to produce unique, human-quality variations. It understands meaning and rewrites with context rather than simple synonym substitution. Content agencies use it to create multiple versions of articles for different audiences or markets.
